description: Interface definition for the Artifact Engine
purpose: Generates and manages artifacts derived from ASH cosmic patterns

methods.name: generate_artifact
methods.description: Generate an artifact from a cosmic pattern

methods.name: destroy_artifact
methods.description: Destroy an artifact and trigger associated events

methods.name: get_artifact_properties
methods.description: Get the cosmic properties of an artifact

methods.name: build_artifact_manifest
methods.description: Create ArtifactManifest and UseConsequenceRoute from ASH provenance.

invariants: All artifacts derive from ASH patterns
Artifact destruction may trigger myth formation
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH remediation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: artifact_manifest
outputs.description: ArtifactManifest emitted under ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: use_consequence_route
outputs.description: UseConsequenceRoute emitted under ASH remediation contract.

outputs.name: myth_seed_candidate
outputs.description: MythSeedCandidate emitted under ASH remediation contract.

ash_remediation_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_remediation_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
